Team,

Quick heads-up: Brightline Health (prospect moving to SOW signature) is asking for Net-90 payment terms and quarterly invoicing due to their internal treasury rules. Quote is $420k ARR; they are asking to use their standard procurement terms which include Net-90, billing each quarter. Sales has recommended making an exception because this is a strategic healthcare customer and the account expansion runway is large.

Attachments: Brightline-RFQ-20251110.pdf, SOW-draft-Brightline-20251111.docx

Asking: Finance/legal approval (and any exec sign-off needed) for Net-90 with the following proposed mitigations:
- Signed PO required prior to first invoice
- Credit application completed and an initial invoice held until PO is received
- Add an extended-term fee (1.0% one-time) to offset receivable risk

Happy to jump on a quick call if helpful — Marissa is looped for commercial context.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer

Thanks Karthik — adding context from the customer side:

- Brightline is a regional provider with a formal procurement cycle; their standard is Net-90.
- They have a signed LOI and want to onboard in Q1. PO will be issued but sometimes gets delayed because of their finance cycle (end-of-quarter cutoffs).
- Procurement asked whether Redwood can accept quarterly invoices (one invoice per quarter) rather than monthly.

They’ve attached their RFQ and a sample PO template. Customer contact: Marie Dubois, VP Procurement.

If we can get an exception it materially accelerates conversion to a paid SOW. If we can’t accept Net-90, they will push us to a longer procurement search and likely another vendor.

I reviewed the deal (BRI-2025-0924) and the risk profile. Approve Net-90 for Brightline Health with the following mandatory conditions:

1) Signed SOW and customer PO must be on file prior to first invoice.
2) Customer completes the credit application and passes our standard credit screening.
3) Add a one-time 1.0% extended-term administrative fee to the first invoice (documented in the SOW).

5) If the customer misses two consecutive payments, account is frozen and an acceleration clause applies (payment becomes due immediately).

Please document these conditions in the SOW and the order form. Legal to confirm clause language; Laura, please add the acceleration language and update the SOW. Rishi, once credit checks are green please clear invoicing. Marissa/Karthik, get the PO signed and upload to the deal record.
